# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

- Local `trajectories/` and `rollouts/val` for the seed held only score rows, no traces. The optimizer had to dig into a sibling run's rollouts/test. Ship seed traces with the work dir.
- Grader feedback text is sometimes misleading: 45944 is reported as int-vs-bool and 188-39 as str-vs-float, while the real issue is the wrong value or source column. Report the expected/actual repr instead.
- The adapter's verify budget resets on every re-save, so an identical resubmission loops to MAX_TURNS. A harness-side "identical block → end task" detector would save turns and noise.

- (cand_0003) When a candidate is rejected with BOTH fixed and broke sets, the framework could auto-suggest (or auto-run) a split: the edit hunks that the broken tasks' traces touched vs the rest. Today the proposer must hand-attribute from traces; a per-hunk "which bullets did this trace quote/echo" helper would make that faster.
- (cand_0003) The rollout file names (`{tid}__{cand}__t0.json`) and the run dir location (`../../` from the work dir, not `.capevolve/run_suite`) are not stated in INSTRUCTIONS.md. A one-line path hint would save the first several tool calls each iteration.
- (cand_0003) The n=40 val with SE≈0.076 cannot resolve 1–2 task moves. A paired re-run of only the tasks whose reward flipped (repeat seeds) would separate variance from edit effects, e.g. for 524-31 / 48975 here.
